diagnostic_reports.result: L4-L5 left paracentral disc protrusion contacting the traversing L5 nerve root.
Full-thickness supraspinatus tear, 1.4 cm, mild retraction.
Grade 2 MCL sprain; no meniscal tear.
Paroxysmal atrial fibrillation, ventricular rate controlled; anticoagulation recommended.
Significant coronary calcification; consider cardiology referral.
